title: The Kiev Trap
subtitle: The developing Kiev encirclement
author: R.G. Cruise
phase: III — The Battle for Strategic Objectives
summary: German mobile thrusts pressed toward a junction east of Kiev while the Soviet Southwestern Front still faced choices about withdrawal.
outlineTopics: The Soviet Southwestern Front and its principal armies.
Mikhail Kirponos and the command structure.
The operational position of Soviet forces around Kiev.
German 2nd Panzer Group advancing from the north.
German 1st Panzer Group advancing from the south.
German operations around the Desna and Seym.
The importance of crossings near Kremenchuk.
German movements toward Romny, Lubny, and Lokhvytsia.
Soviet attempts to defend the flanks and maintain communications.
Stalin's position on withdrawal from Kiev.
Disagreements within Soviet command concerning the developing danger.
The effect of German air power and mobile formations.
The growing separation between Soviet formations and their possible withdrawal routes.
The distinction between a developing encirclement and a completed pocket.
